title: Sheep with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wool body: fluffy cloud -->
  <g fill='#f4f0e6'>
    <circle cx='34' cy='58' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='52' r='14'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='57' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='68' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='41' cy='68' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='47' r='9'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='46' r='9'/>
  </g>
  <!-- wool shading edges for separation -->
  <g fill='#d9d2c2'>
    <circle cx='48' cy='44' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='64' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='64' r='6'/>
  </g>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='74' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
  <rect x='52' y='74' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='35' y='88' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2e24'/>
  <rect x='51' y='88' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2e24'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='40' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#cfc6b4'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='38' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#cfc6b4' transform='rotate(-20 30 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='38' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#cfc6b4' transform='rotate(20 58 38)'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='39' rx='3' ry='3.6' fill='#2b2440'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='39' rx='3' ry='3.6' fill='#2b2440'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='37.5' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='37.5' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='40.5' r='0.6' fill='#9fe8ff'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='40.5' r='0.6' fill='#9fe8ff'/>
  <!-- muzzle & smile -->
  <ellipse cx='44.5' cy='45' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#e8b7c0'/>
  <path d='M41 46 Q44.5 48.5 48 46' stroke='#7a4a52' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
